setupB.title: Setup B · Real-bitcoind soak
setupB.blurb: Class S and Class D check chain against a real mainnet bitcoind under live template flow. Shadow soak has cleared the Class M rejection criterion against a synthetic feed across more than 100,000 templates; Setup B is the next evidence layer.
setupB.blockedOn: Mainnet bitcoind subscription or design-partner stack access.

setupC.title: Setup C · Pool-side design partner soak
setupC.blurb: Live template stream from a participating Stratum V2 pool, mirrored into the verifier in shadow mode. Treats the pool as the source of truth and the verifier as a second pair of eyes; the only path to evidence on real-world template traffic.
setupC.blockedOn: Design partner. Pool operator interest required.

phase15.title: Phase 1.5 · Tier 3 invariant wiring
phase15.blurb: Wired 2026-07-22. All seven Tier 3 invariants (coinbase_script_length, coinbase_output_count, weight_exceeds_max, sigops_exceed_max, non_coinbase_null_prevout, header_version_low, duplicate_tx) are implemented and tested behind the shield facade, bringing the Invariant Shield to 18 of 18 ADR-002 invariants running. Wired is not validated and not yet merged: the change sits on branch, and the merge to main is sequenced after the in-flight re-soak wraps.
phase15.blockedOn: Re-soak wrap 2026-07-29, then merge to main.
